caption: The public address of the test store seen as a visitor: a small logo, the heading Launching soon... the text This store is on a free trial and isn't available to shop at, yet. Please check back soon to browse and buy! A line for the owner with a Log in link, and the label Made with Sellfy at the bottom.

The owner preview of the store through View my store: a dark banner This is your store (customers won't see this banner) with Customize and Dashboard, a round logo with the letter S, the store name Sample Snowboards Shop, the line Explore products and find your favorite and the top of a product card with a grey placeholder picture.

The buyer checkout of the test store: the owner banner, the heading Checkout and a purple notice The store checkout is available to test, but customers can't yet purchase. with the link For customers to purchase, please upgrade. On the left an empty Email field and the optional tick Yes! I want product updates and special offers. On the right the Order summary: Test Wax Guide (PDF) $5, Subtotal $5, Total US$5 and the button Continue. Nothing was filled in.

Select your plan with the switch on Yearly: Starter $22/mo (struck through $348, $264 billed yearly), Business $59/mo ($948, $708 billed yearly) and Premium $119/mo ($1,908, $1,428 billed yearly), each marked +21% VAT, with the first lines Up to $10k, Up to $50k and Up to $200k in sales per year. In the sidebar the store name Sample Snowboards Shop, 2/6 completed and Trial ends in 14 days.
